steps.description:
You can check if a string contains only alphabets by using the isalpha() command. If the string contains only alphabets, it will return True. Otherwise, it will return False.

For examples: string = "aBcD" result = string.isalpha() print(result) < this will display True

string = "aBcD 123 ..." result = string.isalpha() print(result) <- this will display False

Create a function that takes in a string and returns True if it contains only alphabets. Otherwise, it will return False.

Write a program that asks the user to input a string. It will then call your function and display the returned result.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input running

running man

running!!!

007

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input string: running True

Example 2 Input string: running man False

Example 3 Input string: running!!! False

Example 4 Input string: 007 False

Create a function that takes in a string. It will perform the following: 1. Remove all non-alphabet characters in the string 2. Convert the string to uppercase characters 3. Return the result

Write a program that asks the user to input a string. It will then call your function and display the returned result.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - you need to cast your string to list to enable removing of characters.

Test Input running

Running Men!!!

7 running MEN!!!

Wait, 7 running men!?

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input string: running RUNNING

Example 2 Input string: Running Men!!! RUNNINGMEN

Example 3 Input string: 7 running MEN!!! RUNNINGMEN

Example 4 Input string: Wait, 7 running men!? WAITRUNNINGMEN

A palindrome word is word which spells the same backward and forward, such as "Mom" (regardless of letter case).

Create a function that takes in a word string and returns True if it is a palindrome or False if otherwise.

Write a program that asks the user to input a word and call your function to determine if it is a palindrome. Display the returned result.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input levels

NOON

Radar

Aibohphobia

neon

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input word: levels False

Example 2 Input word: NOON True

Example 3 Input word: Radar True

Example 4 Input word: Aibohphobia True

Example 5 Input word: neon False

A palindrome phrase is a phrase that spells the same backwards and forward, such as "Do geese see God?" (regardless of letter case). Characters that are not alphabetical are ignored.

Create a function that takes in a phrase and returns True if the phrase is a palindrome or False if otherwise.

Write a program that asks the user to input a phrase and call your function to determine if it is a palindrome. Based on the returned results, display "Palindrome" or "Not Palindrome" on the screen.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input Do geese see God?

Are you sure you are?

Was it a car, or a cat I saw???

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input phrase: Do geese see God? Palindrome

Example 2 Input phrase: Are you sure you are? Not Palindrome

Example 3 Input phrase: Was it a car, or a cat I saw??? Palindrome
